heading: Scratch-made, all day
body: Menad and Liliana Haliche opened Milo’s in 2024, turning a former motorcycle shop into a European-style neighborhood café. Menad’s experience in Parisian bistros shapes a menu of focaccia sandwiches, crepes, and espresso.
